summary: Boqii Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 14, 2026, reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement on May 11, 2026. The company agreed to issue up to 3,000,000 units at $0.6667 per unit in a private placement under Regulation S, for aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $2,000,100. Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share and one pre-funded warrant exercisable for 2.33 Class A ordinary shares at $0.0001 per share. The warrants are immediately exercisable and expire in two years. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes and working capital. The filing is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
